name: Alternative fate · Isalien

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic · Dungeon Set 2 questline

summary: Isalien left the company for a pilgrimage to Dire Maul, seeking answers about her night elf heritage and perhaps the magic within her amulet piece. Bodley remembers her as a friend of Falrin. In the city’s old kaldorei halls, she was ambushed by Alzzin the Wildshaper and his forces. The manual leaves her at another haunted place: a former companion drawn toward knowledge, then overtaken by the same scattered curse.
